task_instance: Open a sample one-page PDF contract in the interactive PDF viewer and add a highlight annotation to a key term, then verify via screenshot, as a user would ask when saying 'show me this contract and highlight the key terms'.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire mechanism is a set of MCP tools (list_pdfs, display_pdf, interact) exposed by 'a local PDF server' that renders PDFs in a live browser-based viewer and applies annotations/form fills/signatures with real-time visual feedback. None of these tools are present in this runtime's tool list, and a ToolSearch for display_pdf/interact/list_pdfs found no matching deferred tool either (only unrelated connector tools such as Notion file-upload and Google Drive read-file, which are also off-limits per the safety rules). This is not a missing bundled file next to SKILL.md (no scripts/ or templates/ directory exists alongside it, only LICENSE and SKILL.md) -- it is a whole external server/tool integration that the runtime does not grant, and it inherently requires a live interactive viewer (a UI surface) that a headless offline shell cannot provide even if the server binary were present. Per the task rules, I did not write a replacement/stub/shim for the PDF server or fabricate its outputs (e.g. screenshots, viewUUIDs, annotation results).
evidence: Read SKILL.md at /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_gr/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__view-pdf/SKILL.md, confirming the skill is entirely built around the MCP tools list_pdfs/display_pdf/interact from 'a local PDF server'. Confirmed no such capability exists in this offline runtime's tool surface. Did not attempt to build a stub PDF viewer or fabricate screenshot/annotation output, per the task's explicit prohibition.
